messages:
maria: hi all, first day here! trying to run the repo's example workflow (ci.yml) and the job fails with 'Resource not accessible by integration'. Googling suggests GITHUB_TOKEN perms but not sure what to change as a new hire. any quick pointers?

alex: welcome maria! that error usually means the action is trying to do something the GITHUB_TOKEN can't, like write checks or access secrets from org-level settings for a repo it's not allowed on. which step is failing? paste the snippet if you can.

maria: here's the relevant log: 
```
Run ./scripts/deploy-preview.sh
Error: Resource not accessible by integration
at /home/runner/work/_actions/org/action/entrypoint.js:45:13
```

eng-infra-mentor: hey @maria, congrats on joining. two quick things to check: 1) is the repo a fork/your personal fork? workflows from forks run with a limited GITHUB_TOKEN. 2) repo settings -> Actions -> Workflow permissions, make sure it's set to 'Read and write' if the job needs to create PR comments/checks.

maria: repo is under the org (infra/ci-examples) not a fork. I don't have repo settings access though.

alex: if it's an org repo, the org-level Actions policy could be restricting selected repositories for org secrets. Also if the workflow uses an org secret (organization-level secret), that secret must be specifically allowed for this repo. The error could come from trying to access a secret that the integration can't see.

maria: the workflow tries to post a check run and read an org secret named DOCKER_REGISTRY. the step is `echo ${{ secrets.DOCKER_REGISTRY }}` (weirdly used in a script).

eng-infra-mentor: posting check runs requires write permission to checks and statuses. The default GITHUB_TOKEN created for actions has permissions set by the repo (in settings -> Actions -> General). Our onboarding policy requires 'Read and write' for new CI repos. I'll ping infra-admins to confirm. @alex can you check org secrets permissions?

alex: pinging @security-bot to confirm DOCKER_REGISTRY availability.

security-bot: security-bot: Org secret DOCKER_REGISTRY is set but limited to the following repositories: infra/ci-examples-legacy. Not currently enabled for infra/ci-examples.

maria: ah ok that's the issue. do new repos automatically get the secret enabled? I created infra/ci-examples from the template during onboarding.

eng-infra-mentor: when we create a repo from template the org secret access isn't automatically enabled. We normally add the repo to the secret allowlist via the infra-admins role or a small checklist step: enable-org-secret -> add-repo. I'll add it to the onboarding checklist so new repos don't block first builds.

alex: for now, two options: 1) switch the workflow to use a repo secret (if you can add one) or 2) ask infra-admins to add infra/ci-examples to the DOCKER_REGISTRY secret allowlist. I'll add a one-off ACL change.

alex: done, I added the repo to the secret's allowed repos. infra-admins will audit it but this is fine for an onboarding sample.

ci-bot: github-actions: workflow run #12 re-run by maria 680 

maria: re-ran the job and it's now past the deploy-preview step, build succeeded! thanks.

eng-infra-mentor: nice. follow-up notes for you @maria: 1) if a workflow needs to create checks/comments, confirm 'Workflow permissions' are Read & write. 2) org secrets must be enabled per-repo when using selected repositories. 3) if you hit 'Resource not accessible by integration' again paste the exact step log and someone will help. we'll add a short blurb to the onboarding doc about org secret allowlists and repo templates.

maria: great, I'll file a tiny PR to the onboarding checklist to mention enabling secrets and asking infra-admins. thanks everyone :)
